```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```
load packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
```
load data
```{r}
data <- read_csv("~/Downloads/Independent project/Wood Lab MSB/data/all_lots_okay_to_dissect.csv") %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()
```
filter data
```{r}
hybama_only <- data %>% 
  filter(scientific_name %in% c("Hybognathus amarus"))
hybama_impact <- hybama_only %>% 
  filter(ci %in% c("impact"))
```
Plot
```{r}
hist(hybama_only$individual_count)

ggplot(hybama_only,
       aes(x = year_collected, y = individual_count)) +
  geom_point() + theme_minimal()
```
